title: NPEPPS Is a Druggable Driver of Platinum Resistance
model: Bladder cancer cell lines (KU1919, 5637), whole-genome CRISPR knockout library
contrast: Gemcitabine+cisplatin vs saline, day 15 (3 vs 3 per line; both lines pooled with a cell-line term)
paper_calls: 46 genes sensitising resistant lines to GC; NPEPPS the novel hit, mostly DNA-damage/repair genes
barcs_calls: 201 genes at FDR 0.10 pooled (178 depleted); no controls, no control null
named_hits: NPEPPS a top-5 sensitiser in every contrast (#4 pooled); UBE2T, RAD18, MUS81, XPA, FANCA all top 6
verdict: BARCS independently ranks NPEPPS among the top five sensitisers in both cell lines and recovers the Fanconi/DNA-repair signal the paper describes; a full table overlap is not possible because the paper's gene list is paywalled.
